footnotes.text: A January 1841 revelation appointed Vinson Knight “to preside over the Bishoprick,” but records thereafter do not show him functioning in that role. At the April 1841 general conference, for example, no mention was made of Knight as presiding over the other bishops (“Revelation, 19 January 1841 [D&C 124],”in Book of the Law of the Lord, 3–15,josephsmithpapers.org; “Minutes of the general conference of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints,”Times and Seasons,Apr. 15, 1841, 386–88; William Clayton journal, Apr. 6–9, 1841, Church History Library, Salt Lake City).
